description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快捷调节波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度与自动昼夜循环。
description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with quick controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity, and an automatic day cycle.

description.zh: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮原文；选中即问不打断阅读。基于上游 v1.6.0 的智枢二次打包。
description.en: Paper-reading companion: literature library, PDF reader, and tutor-style study. Answers cite page numbers; click to jump back and highlight the source. Zhishu build based on upstream v1.6.0.

description.zh: 离线转换 Dify 工具包和 Xinference 模型提供商。支持单独安装命令行转换器，也可从可视化工作流的「迁移 Dify 工具」入口上传 .difypkg 或 ZIP。
description.en: Convert Dify tool packages and Xinference model providers offline. Install the command-line compiler separately or upload .difypkg or ZIP files from Visual Workflow’s Dify migration action.

description.zh: 可视化编排 Agent 工作流，支持导入 Dify 工作流和批量迁移兼容的工具与 Xinference 模型提供商。安装包包含离线迁移器、运行依赖和本地向量模型。
description.en: Compose Agent workflows, import Dify workflows, and migrate compatible tools and Xinference model providers in batches. The offline package includes the migrator, runtime dependencies, and a local embedding model.
